description: A stack of damp franchise flyers and a bucket of paste. Slap them up across the Strip, Threshold Plaza North, and the Marquee. Nobody reads them. That's not the point. 15₵.
name: Papering the Strip

emotes: {who} slaps a flyer over three older flyers and smooths it down with a paste-slick hand.
{who} papers a wall on the Strip, getting more glue on themselves than the brick.
{who} steps back to admire a crooked flyer, decides it's fine, and moves on.
{who} pastes a flyer to a dead kiosk in Plaza North, right over the missing-persons notice.
{who} works down the plaza, one flyer per pillar, whistling something tuneless.
{who} peels a flyer off their own sleeve and sticks it to the nearest flat surface.
{who} slaps the last flyers up under the Marquee lights and flicks paste off their fingers.
{who} papers over a rival franchise's flyers with grim satisfaction.
{who} runs out of paste, licks the last flyer, and presses it to the wall anyway.
